instructions: To resume ANY time: open this folder in VS Code, then tell me 'continue'. I will read state.json and pick up at currentLesson. To jump ahead, edit currentLesson in state.json. Questions asked do NOT advance the lesson. CONFIRMATION PROTOCOL: I will ALWAYS ask 'Have you completed the homework for Lesson N? Reply yes or no.' before advancing. Only 'yes' marks the lesson complete and increments currentLesson. CONFIDENCE PROTOCOL: After each lesson I will ask you to rate your confidence (1-5) and a quick check; I'll record it here.

waitProtocol.note: When user says 'wait', set active=true and pausedAt=now. When user says 'pass on', set active=false and resume the interrupted response. Lesson state NEVER changes during a wait.

confidenceProtocol.note: After each lesson you'll be asked a simple confidence question and a 1-5 rating. I'll store the answer in this file. This helps us know how well you grasp the material.
